title: Create: Rewired Resource Pack
body:
## **Create: Rewired Resource Pack**
A polished Fabric 1.20.1 resource pack designed for the Create: Rewired SMP. It enhances UI visuals, fixes buggy textures, and refines textures (mainly GUI) to match the theme and engineering style of the server.

![Main Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f2bf321f968377126543b91446c11f29ca3b613.png)

### **Discord Server**
- https://discord.gg/63JyUuDWNT _(applications to this SMP will apply)_
